title: Optimiq Voice telephony vocabularies
description: Closed string vocabularies shared across event families. Authority: packages/events/src/schemas/telephony.ts.

LegSide.description: A-leg is the originating/inbound side; B-leg is every leg the engine originated for it.

CallDirection.description: Direction as the organization sees it, not as the switch sees it.

HangupSide.description: Which side tore the call down; system covers engine/media timeouts and admin hangups.

DTMFSource.description: DTMF transports, from the frozen reference §4.

RecordingKind.description: What produced a stored media object.

AgentStatus.description: ACD agent status. Drives queue distribution and the wallboard.
